# Brendan Parker MD

> Orthopedic physician assistant based in Edmonds, Washington, specializing in physical therapy, ultrasound-guided injections, and orthopedic care.

Dr. Brendan Parker is a physician assistant providing orthopedic care in Edmonds, WA. This site serves as a resource for patients and referring providers, offering information on clinical services, an interactive exercise library organized by body region and pathology, ultrasound-guided injection details, and clinic contact information.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of clinical services and patient resources.
- [About](/about): Background, credentials, and clinical philosophy.
- [Services](/services): Orthopedic and physical therapy services offered.
- [Contact](/contact): Clinic location, contact form, and appointment details.
- [PT Locations](/pt-locations): Directory of physical therapy clinic locations.

## Resources

- [Exercise Library](/exercise-library): Browse physical therapy exercises by body region and specific pathologies.
- [Exercise Search](/exercise-library/search): Search the full exercise library by keyword.
- [Shoulder Region](/exercise-library/region/shoulder): Exercises and guidance for shoulder conditions.
- [Shoulder Pathologies](/exercise-library/region/shoulder/pathology/rotator-cuff-tendinopathy): Condition-specific shoulder exercises (e.g., rotator cuff tendinopathy).
- [Ultrasound-Guided Injections](/ultrasound): Overview of ultrasound-guided joint and soft-tissue injections.
- [Knee Joint Injection](/ultrasound/knee-joint-injection): Details on the knee joint injection procedure.
